metadata.description: Two Claude Code mods for running many sessions at once: a context card above the prompt and a sessions pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: context-card
plugins.description: Context window breakdown, prompt-cache state and weekly plan usage, in one line above the prompt.

plugins.name: pr-pane
plugins.description: Every session of the project with its worktree, PR and status in a side pane, and one click to ask about them.
